headlines.title: 7月住户贷款减少超4600亿元
headlines.summary: 【7月住户贷款减少超4600亿元】近日，中国人民银行公示《2026年7月金融统计数据报告》，对比此前数据显示，7月住户贷款减少4603亿元。其中，居民短贷减少3400亿元，居民中长贷减少1202亿元。记者采访了解到，居民贷款减少这主要受房地产市场持续调整、居民消费意愿不足等因素影响。未来随着逆周期调节力度加大，经济增长动能有望增强，居民贷款或回升。

headlines.title_en: Household loans fell by more than 460 billion yuan in July
headlines.summary_en: [Household loans fell over 460 billion yuan in July] The PBOC recently published the July 2026 financial statistics report, showing household loans dropped by 460.3 billion yuan in July. Among them, short-term household loans fell by 340 billion yuan and medium/long-term household loans by 120.2 billion yuan. Reporting suggests the decline was mainly due to ongoing property market adjustments and weak consumer willingness to borrow. As counter-cyclical policy intensifies, economic momentum could strengthen and household loans may recover.

headlines.title_en: MIIT Vice Minister Xin Guobin: In the first half of the year, revenue of above-scale robotics enterprises reached 165.5 billion yuan, up 24.5% year-on-year
headlines.summary_en: At the opening ceremony of the 2026 World Robot Conference, Vice Minister of Industry and Information Technology Xin Guobin stated that in 2025, revenue of enterprises above designated size in the robotics industry exceeded 300 billion yuan, with an average annual growth rate of over 20% in the past five years. In the first half of this year, revenue reached 165.5 billion yuan, up 24.5% year on year. Robotic technologies and products have been widely applied across all aspects of national economic and social development, becoming a significant force driving high-quality growth.

headlines.title: 王毅同智利外长佩雷斯会谈
headlines.summary: 8月19日，中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅在北京同智利外长佩雷斯举行会谈。王毅说，中智传统友谊源远流长，是隔洋相望的好朋友、好伙伴。智利是首个同新中国建交的南美国家，也是第一个同中国签署自由贸易协定的拉美国家，在发展对华关系上超越党派异同，始终走在拉美和加勒比国家前列。中智关系发展最重要的经验在于双方奉行独立自主外交政策，坚持相互尊重、平等相待，坚持优势互补、互利共赢。今年是中智建立全面战略伙伴关系10周年，中方愿同智新政府一道，赓续传统友谊，深化务实合作，推动中智关系迈上新台阶。

headlines.title_en: Wang Yi holds talks with Chilean Foreign Minister Perez
headlines.summary_en: On August 19, Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Minister of Foreign Affairs, held talks with Chilean Foreign Minister Alberto van Klaveren in Beijing. Wang Yi said that China-Chile traditional friendship has a long history, making them good friends and good partners across the ocean. Chile was the first South American country to establish diplomatic relations with New China and the first Latin American country to sign a free trade agreement with China, consistently leading Latin American and Caribbean countries in relations with China while transcending partisan differences. The most important experience of China-Chile relations lies in both sides pursuing independent foreign policies, adhering to mutual respect and equal treatment, and upholding complementary advantages and mutual benefit. This year marks the 10th anniversary of the China-Chile comprehensive strategic partnership. China is willing to work with Chile's new government to carry forward traditional friendship, deepen practical cooperation, and elevate bilateral relations to a new level.

headlines.title: 国台办回应台“汉光”演习：“台独”分裂是台海和平稳定的最大威胁

headlines.title_en: Taiwan Affairs Office responds to Taiwan's 'Han Kuang' exercise: 'Taiwan independence' separatist activities are the greatest threat to cross-strait peace and stability
headlines.summary_en: The State Council Taiwan Affairs Office held a regular press conference. A reporter asked: Recently, the DPP authorities held the so-called 'Han Kuang 42 exercise,' which for the first time included a mobile network slowdown drill. Society on the island questioned that this 'network disconnection' drill prevents people from ordering food delivery or using payment cards for purchases, disrupting daily life. What is the spokesperson's comment on this?

headlines.title: 上海张江高新技术产业开发区发展“十五五”规划：加快大飞机关键材料与核心零部件检验检测等平台建设
headlines.summary: 上海市科学技术委员会印发《上海张江高新技术产业开发区发展“十五五”规划》，其中提出，聚焦民用航空发动机、机载系统、复合材料、航空制造装备、新型低空航空器等细分领域，发挥龙头企业牵引作用，以整机带动技术攻关和本土产业链培育，推动实施航空发动机研制工程等重点项目，加快大飞机关键材料与核心零部件检验检测等平台建设，提升适航审定等配套服务保障能力。支持临港园聚焦大飞机产业链，紫竹高新区聚焦航电系统开发，金山园聚焦工业级无人机等产业细分领域，加速商业化应用示范和规模化发展。

headlines.title_en: Shanghai Zhangjiang High-Tech Industrial Development Zone's 15th Five-Year Plan: accelerate construction of platforms for inspection and testing of key materials and core components for large aircraft
headlines.summary_en: The Shanghai Municipal Science and Technology Commission issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Shanghai Zhangjiang High-Tech Industrial Development Zone,' proposing to focus on sub-sectors including civil aviation engines, airborne systems, composite materials, aviation manufacturing equipment, and new low-altitude aircraft. Leveraging the leading role of flagship enterprises, it aims to drive technological breakthroughs and local industrial chain cultivation through complete aircraft, promote key projects such as the aviation engine development program, accelerate the construction of platforms for inspection and testing of large aircraft key materials and core components, and enhance supporting service capabilities such as airworthiness certification. It also supports Lingang Park in focusing on the large aircraft industrial chain, Zizhu High-Tech Zone on avionics system development, and Jinshan Park on industrial-grade drones and other niche sectors, accelerating commercial application demonstration and scaled development.
